description: Sends an encrypted message to a specific Chat conversation. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. A recipient who cannot be messaged (closed inbox, system/notification account, or a 1:1 block) returns HTTP 403 with type https://api.x.com/2/problems/recipient-not-messageable.

encoded_message_create_event.description: Base64-encoded Thrift MessageCreateEvent containing encrypted message contents.

encoded_message_event_signature.description: Base64-encoded Thrift MessageEventSignature for message verification.

xdk_version.description: Version of the Chat XDK that produced the payload.
